claims.summary: For every n>=1, over F2 in two free letters let Z_n=sum_(j=0)^n x0^j and Q_n=sum_(t=0)^floor(n/3) Z_n(x1 Z_n)^(3t). Full ordered powers and duplicated subformulas give formula size O(n^4), ordered unbounded-fanin depth<=4,degree<=n²+2n. For each length-n word x_b1...x_bn, its coefficient is1 iff sum b_i=0 mod3, by unique zero-run decomposition. Every bipartition flattening of the degree-n word tensor has F2 rank<=3, since rows depend only on count mod3. The Boolean word-query function has no polynomial-size fixed-depth AC0[2] circuits by the recorded Smolensky consequence. Thus no generic word-coefficient query guarantee, uniform in growing query length and polynomial degree, has size polynomial in original formula size, degree and query length with depth bounded only by original formula depth. Does not cover fixed query length, all components of Q, or claim hard evaluation of Q; Q is a polynomial, not an asserted compiler image or hard CNF. Complete-certificate specialization is a separately owed lemma-first consequence, not registered here.

No certificate-image or hard-family conclusion.
